searchText: mega-spec layout - I think containers should come before data sections. This makes appending data to the container much easier. Possibly re-number kinds? Here's besu's Mega-EOF, right now just with the subcontainer layout chainges - https://github.com/shemnon/besu/tree/mega-eof We should specify and enforce a maximum subcontainer nesting level. I think I can make a monster 2,457 deep container if I tried hard enough. Maybe 4? Does someone know if there is an implementation of MPT proofs in EVM somewhere? like `eth_getProof`? That just returns the witnesses. Are you also looking for execution against that proof? Perhaps we extend the 256 limit on sub-containers to include all nested subcontainers from the top level container? That limits the deepest nesting to 256 as well.
